citation: Aure,J.,Svendsen,E.,Rey,F.,Skjoldal,H.R.(1990),The Jutland Current:nutrients and physical oceanographic conditions in late autumn1989,ICESCM1990/C:35.
source_locator: Printed6/PDFpage6,Water volumes and total amounts of nutrients; printed7/PDFpage7,equation5 and Table2 Ha(m) column.
extraction_method: Manual transcription after visual review of original cloud-retained PDF pages6and7. No plot digitization or raw cruise-data extraction.
geographic_scope: Source Jutland Coastal Water inventory between55degreesN and Limfjord on the west-Denmark coast; not whole Jutland route,Skagerrak,Baltic or Norwegian Coastal continuation.
source_survey_condition: Jutland Current partly blocked during survey; source distinguishes JCW from strengthened Atlantic/Northern Jutland inflow.
interpretation: Source-reported regional area-mean water depth for the salinity-selected inventory. Not a station bottom,current velocity boundary,uniform full-current thickness,seasonal range,uncertainty or new OSW volume estimate.
